import html # Example template – replace placeholders with actual values. USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{title}

by {author}

{body}
{tags}
""" def generate_post_html(author: str, title: str, body: str, post_tags: list[str]) -> str: """ Generate a sanitized HTML representation of a user's post. Args: author (str): The author of the post. title (str): The title of the user's post. body (str): The main content of the user's post. post_tags (list[str]): A list of tags associated with the post. Returns: str: The sanitized HTML string for the post. """ # Escape all user-provided content to prevent XSS safe_author = html.escape(author, quote=True) safe_title = html.escape(title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(body, quote=False) # Build the tags section tag_spans = [] for tag in post_tags: safe_tag = html.escape(tag, quote=True) tag_spans.append(f'{safe_tag}') tags_html = " ".join(tag_spans) # Render the template with sanitized values html_output = USER_POST_FORMAT.format( title=safe_title, author=safe_author, body=safe_body, tags=tags_html ) return html_output.strip()
